species.pebble_damsel: Small, bold and first aboard. Every great aquarium starts with one brave damsel.
species.carpet_anemone: A soft, swaying welcome mat. Clownfish think it's the finest home on the coast.
species.clownfish: Lives safely among stinging tentacles. Waves at children, mostly on purpose.
species.mudskipper: A fish that walks, hops and climbs the glass to see the view.
species.pistol_shrimp: Snaps its claw so fast the water pops. Digs a burrow for two.
species.watchman_goby: Stands guard at the shrimp's door and flicks its tail at any danger.
species.garibaldi: A golden lantern of the kelp forest. Fiercely tidy about its garden.
species.kelp_seahorse: Curls its tail around kelp like a scarf. Fathers carry the babies.
species.leafy_seadragon: Dressed head to tail as seaweed. Spotting one counts as good luck.
species.ice_krill: A shimmering cloud of tiny swimmers. Small alone, magnificent together.
species.icefish: Clear blood, glassy fins and the calmest temper under the ice.
species.snow_crab: Walks sideways through the snow-cold deep on long, careful legs.
species.tubeworm: Red plumes rising from warm vents, a garden that grows on volcano heat.
species.yeti_crab: Farms tiny food in its fuzzy arms. Waves them gently to keep it growing.
species.scaly_snail: Wears a shell plated in iron. The bravest snail in any sea.
species.vent_octopus: Pale, patient and curious about every latch on the train.
species.ghost_ray: Glides like a breath of moonlight. Rarely seen, never forgotten.
species.pocket_whale: A whale small enough for a carriage, with a song big enough for the sea.
